name: HeyGen
tagline: Turns scripts into talking-head videos using realistic AI avatars and cloned voices.
tldr: HeyGen is an AI video platform centered on realistic AI avatars, lip-syncing, and voice cloning for turning text scripts directly into talking-head videos.
Best for marketing teams, sales/training content, and creators who need localized or multilingual talking-head video without filming.
Popular for use cases like translated/dubbed speeches and corporate training, with an avatar quality widely praised as some of the most realistic in the category.
Runs on a credit-based subscription (Free, Creator, Pro, Business, Enterprise) where different avatar/video features (e.g. Avatar IV) consume credits at different rates.
Review sites show a split reputation: strong product/quality scores on sites like G2, but notably weaker Trustpilot scores driven by billing, cancellation, and support complaints.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: ~600 credits/month, videos up to ~30 min, watermark removed, 1 voice clone

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Starts at 1,000 credits, adds 4K export; higher usage tiers scale credits with price

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Sales-led quote; custom avatars, API access, org-wide controls

pros: Avatar realism and lip-sync quality are frequently singled out as best-in-class for the category
Strong for multilingual/dubbed content (translation plus lip-sync in one workflow)
Simple script-to-video workflow makes it accessible to non-video-editors
Wide range of avatars and voice options for different use cases (training, sales, marketing)
cons: Credit system is widely criticized as opaque, with credits consumed even on failed renders
Trustpilot reviews report difficulty canceling subscriptions and unexpected charges
Pricing scales quickly once you need higher-volume avatar video (e.g. Avatar IV) beyond entry-level credits
Support responsiveness is a recurring complaint, especially around billing disputes

sentiment.quote: For what I need: a real person, with perfect lip synching, custom voices etc... It's perfect.

The credit system is completely opaque – credits burn up incredibly fast because HeyGen deliberately does everything to make you buy more. New videos are blocked after the first failed attempt, forcing you to top up credits to continue.
I tried canceling the account, but there was no way to do so...Everything is confusing

bestFor: Marketing and L&D teams producing talking-head videos at scale without filming
Multilingual content teams needing dubbed/lip-synced localization
Sales teams creating personalized video outreach
Solo creators who want a realistic avatar presenter without a camera setup
hotTake: HeyGen's avatars get near-perfect praise for realism, but its own review pages show a stark split — 4.8/5 on G2 for the product versus roughly 2.3/5 on Trustpilot once billing and cancellation are in the picture.
